column1: # Potentia dictionary registry. One dictionary per line, tab-separated.
#   id           Name used with --dict (letters, digits, - and _).
#   file         Word list in this folder: one word per line, a-z only for the lower27 line.
#   language     Language code (e.g. en). Informational for now; later lines will select by it.
#   default      "yes" on exactly one line: the dictionary used when --dict is not given.
#   sha256       SHA-256 of the file. The file is refused if it does not match, so a result
#                recorded with a dictionary id can always be reproduced with the same words.
#   description  One line, shown by `potentia dicts`.
# To add a dictionary: put the file in this folder, run `potentia dicts --hash FILE` to get its
# SHA-256, and add a line here. Never change an existing line's file or hash: add a new id.
